_doc: Allowlist for the RLS policy guard at scripts/check_rls_policies.js. Every entry MUST include a real reason that survives review. The guard fails CI if anything outside this file goes permissive or RLS-off.

deny_all_tables.reason: Intentional lockdown (20260707205002): all reads/upserts flow through app/api/messenger/link-preview using the service-role client. RLS on + zero policies = deny-by-default for anon/authenticated.
Intentional lockdown (20260707205002): share links are read via the server page and inserted via API, both service-client. Direct PostgREST access denied.
Signup verification codes (20260707223000): issued and checked exclusively by service-client auth routes. Must never be readable by anon/authenticated.
20260707120001 explicitly revokes browser roles and enables RLS without policies: OAuth credentials are read/refreshed only by lib/social/tokens.ts service client; never expose tokens to browsers.
20260707120001 explicitly uses service-role-only RLS deny-all; server social admin, ingest and existing publication routes own the queue. No browser row access.
20260711235500 intentionally enables RLS with no policies for the COA counter; 20260711190000 next_lot_seq SECURITY DEFINER RPC grants EXECUTE only to service_role.
20260711340000 explicitly protects the visitor/user/UTM map with no browser policies; record_attribution SECURITY DEFINER and service reporting own access.
20260712020002 explicitly declares append-only service-role send telemetry; lib/email.ts writes via admin client. Browser access must remain denied.
20260714171500 explicitly declares service-role-only deny-all tracking; lifecycle-nudges server route uses admin client to claim once-per-user sends.
20260714172000 explicitly declares service-role-only RLS deny-all; authenticated admin API app/api/admin/email-blast owns campaign records using server client.
20260714172500 explicitly declares service-role-only RLS deny-all; admin email-template API and server email-overrides module own access.
20260714200000 explicitly states no policies is intentional: service-role admin API only, no authenticated-user or public access.
20260723090000 explicitly denies all direct browser access because rows hold encrypted provider credentials; service-role shipping APIs return only safe fields.
20260730125733 explicitly declares service-role-only append-only attribution audit, RLS with no policies and revoked browser table/sequence access; lib/attribution-log.ts owns writes.

permissive_policies.reason: Anon storefront analytics — insert-only event log used by the storefront grid to record view/add-to-cart events for funnel analysis. Append-only; admins read.

Reactions are visible to any participant of the conversation. Legacy policy from messenger v1; safe because participation is enforced on the parent messenger_messages SELECT policy and reactions only ever join through it.
Stores the public-facing referral bonus amounts shown on /referrals and inside the agent dashboard. Single-row config table; no PII.
Public flat-rate shipping tiers shown on the checkout page and the public Shipping page. Anonymous quotes must work pre-login.
Public research knowledge base — compound monographs are the site's public catalog/SEO content. Read-only; writes gated by admin policies.
Published literature citations (PMID/DOI) rendered on public monograph pages. No user data; writes require is_admin().
Cache of public PubMed API responses used to render evidence tabs. Source data is already public; writes require is_admin().
ClinicalTrials.gov records (public registry data) shown on monograph Trials tabs. Writes require is_admin().
WADA prohibited-list history (public regulatory data) shown on monographs. Writes require is_admin().
Citation footnotes for monograph facts — public evidence layer. Writes require is_admin().
UniProt ortholog data (public bioinformatics data) on monographs. Writes require is_admin().
ChEMBL binding-affinity data (public database) on monographs. Writes require is_admin().
NIH RePORTER grant/funding records (public data) on monographs. Writes require is_admin().
FDA recall/safety alerts — deliberately public safety information. Writes require is_admin().
Protein Data Bank structure metadata (public data) on monographs. Writes require is_admin().
Computed related-papers listing derived from public literature. Writes require is_admin().

Historical: dropped by 20260707205002 (service-client lockdown). Entry kept only because the policy still appears in older migration files' final-state reconstruction if the drop migration is edited; harmless either way.

20260710120000 explicitly defines public SELECT of reserved slug keys for availability; 20260712020000 intentionally retains this policy and removes its duplicate. Read-only non-secret namespace reservations; no public writes.
